cards.title: Residual Error Model Diagnostics and Definitions
cards.claim: Residual error represents unexplained variability. Diagnostics must evaluate the fit of the residual error model using specific plots: DV vs IPRED/xPRED, |IWRES| vs IPRED/time, and Q-Q plots of random effects. Shrinkage measures the extent to which Empirical Bayes Estimates (EBE) depend on population parameters rather than individual data.
conditions: Applicable during model development and validation.
Requires individual predictions (IPRED) and weighted residuals (IWRES/xWRES).
Time should be evaluated as continuous time and time after dose.
limitations: No single validation method is sufficient; multiple diagnostics are required.
Outliers must be distinguished from model misspecification; removal of outliers requires prespecified criteria and sensitivity analysis.
Shrinkage indicates limited information for individual parameters, affecting reliability of EBEs.
cards.downstream_use: Use diagnostic plots to refine residual error structure (additive/proportional/combined); assess model adequacy; identify outliers for sensitivity analysis.
cards.retrieval_keywords: Residual and censored observation models and structural/practical identifiability
